description: Messages from customers, judged for tone (new phrasing, new statements).

key.instructions: The writer is annoyed or angry

s2.instructions: The writer threatens to cancel, leave or escalate

Quick heads-up: the update logged everyone out this morning. We signed back in and all is fine now, thanks for the fast release notes.
I'm not angry, just curious: is there a keyboard shortcut for archiving?
Not curious anymore, just angry: nobody has answered my billing question in two weeks. If I don't hear back today I'm taking this to your CEO.
